comment: do.c flooreffects() lines 209-219: a boulder moving on a monster's turn (svc.context.mon_moving) that lands in a pit holding a trapped monster applies dmgval() directly and, when the victim dies, prints "<Mon> is killed!" if the hero can spot it. A hero-caused boulder takes the hmon() arm instead, so a monster must set the boulder moving. In wizard mode the hero wishes for a rolling boulder trap, whose launch boulder lies four squares west, teleports two squares toward it and wishes for a pit on the boulder's path, and creates an ogre. Teleporting diagonally away draws the ogre into the pit. The hero then creates a jackal and teleports so that the jackal's approach crosses the rolling boulder trap. The jackal triggers it, the boulder hits the trapped ogre (trap.c launch_obj() -> mthrowu.c ohitmon()) and falls into the pit, and flooreffects() kills the ogre.
